topic: Huailai Smart Space AI Industrial Park (怀来县智慧空间人工智能产业园), Xiaonanxinpu town, Huailai: red-line parcel centroid of the official 2024 site plan registered to Esri World Imagery, with a location check from the official land-use analysis map
candidate: Huailai Smart Space AI Industrial Park (怀来县智慧空间人工智能产业园项目), Shibajia and Xiaonanxinpu villages, Xiaonanxinpu town, Huailai County, Zhangjiakou, Hebei; builder 华夏雅库(河北)网络科技有限公司

selected_point.role: Area centroid of the red-line parcel (用地红线, parcel GY22-46, 69,941.54 m2) drawn on the official 2024 site plan, transformed to WGS84 by an affine registration of the plan to Esri World Imagery. It falls inside the footprint of the 4# data-centre building. It marks the parcel, not a building centre, entrance or surveyed position.
selected_point.rounding: Five decimal places (about 1 m); decimals are not accuracy.

site_plan.title: 总平面图 技术指标 sheet attached to the Huailai County Spatial Planning Committee Office pre-approval publicity of the project detailed plan, 1 April 2024
site_plan.content: CAD site plan stating 坐标系：2000系 and 高程基准：1985 (no coordinate values printed); north arrow up; parcel GY22-46, land certificate 冀（2023）怀来县不动产权第0017877号; red-line parcel between 经一路 (west) and 观湖路 (east); six four-storey data-centre buildings 1#-6# (丙类厂房, 24.4 m) in three rows, the 1号110kV变电站 at the west end of the middle row, a buried oil-tank area (地埋式储油区) between it and 4#, the 2号110kV变电站 at the south-west corner. Indicators: planned land 69,941.54 m2; total floor area 155,785.00 m2, of which data centre 149,361.38 m2 and each 110 kV substation 2,127.70 m2 above ground plus 685.10 m2 below; fire-control centre and guard room 84.15 m2.

land_use_analysis_map.title: 用地分析 sheet attached to the same 1 April 2024 publicity
land_use_analysis_map.capture_note: Captured with a single curl GET after capture.mjs aborted three times at its 45 s timeout on this 22 MB file (failure metadata kept).
land_use_analysis_map.content: Web-map imagery panel with labels: G6 京藏高速 across the top, road Y127 running north-south, 葡萄大道 east-west, the 东环兴业产业园 and 科力恒久产业园 factory blocks north-east of the site, 中国空间技术研究院怀来建设管理中心 to the south-east; a red box marked 项目用地 west of Y127 and south of 葡萄大道. The panel shows the site as farmland (pre-construction imagery).

esri_imagery.role: context (G6, Y127, 葡萄大道, industrial park)

pixel_to_lonlat: Esri export with bboxSR=imageSR=4326: lon = xmin + (col + 0.5) / width * (xmax - xmin); lat = ymax - (row + 0.5) / height * (ymax - ymin), using the extent returned by the f=json response (identical to the request).

site_plan_registration.method: Least-squares six-parameter affine from site-plan pixels to WGS84 lon/lat, fitted to eight building corners identified on both the plan and the Esri close-up (pure Python, offline). Plan pixels were read on a 2000-pixel-wide working copy and are given here at full resolution (factor 4.9665).
site_plan_registration.area_check: The transformed red-line parcel measures 70,461 m2 against the stated 69,941.54 m2 (+0.7%), an independent check of scale; the red-line corners were read by eye, so the area difference is not an accuracy figure.

location_check_from_land_use_map.method: Affine from the land-use analysis map imagery panel (full-resolution pixels) to the Esri context export, four road controls read by eye.

controls.feature: Y127 passing under the G6 expressway
industrial park western road and Putao Avenue junction

location_check_from_land_use_map.result: The hand-drawn 项目用地 box of the official location map lands on the same campus, its centroid 44 m from the selected point. The coarse web-map panel and hand-drawn box explain the 20 m RMS.

imagery_observation: The undated Esri close-up shows, inside a parallelogram parcel whose east side follows the north-south road (Y127, drawn as 观湖路 on the plan), six large buildings in three rows of two, the middle pair with courtyards, a small building at the west end of the middle row and another at the south-west corner, matching 1#-6# and the two 110 kV substations of the site plan. Tower cranes and unfinished roofs show the image predates completion; no physical status is taken from imagery. The land-use map panel (2024) shows the parcel as farmland.
identity_chain: The 5 August 2026 planning verification names the project, builder, villages, project code and permits, and lists 1#-6# data centres and the No. 1 and No. 2 110 kV substations as the verified buildings.

The 1 April 2024 publicity of the same project (same builder, villages and project name) attaches the site plan with exactly these buildings and the location map placing the parcel west of Y127 and south of 葡萄大道 near the G6 expressway.
Esri imagery at the registered position shows a campus with the plan's unique layout; the registered parcel area matches the stated area within 0.7%.
privacy: No personal data is transcribed; the builder is a company and its registered village address is not reproduced.
